status: No concrete formula, units, weight, normalizer or paired-pool bug found in the uploaded exports.

source_parity_contract.pool: all available source records for every network task, no within-task split, no error-code filter, no deduplication
source_parity_contract.weighting: network task extraction occurrence weights; ratio of weighted latency sums, not average scores or record-count weights
source_parity_contract.normalizer: minimum full-task float32(mean raw record costs) seconds
source_parity_contract.label: float32(full-task minimum / record float32 cost)
source_parity_contract.metric: sum(w * minimum) / sum(w * min(minimum / max(label, 1e-5) among first K))
source_parity_contract.arithmetic: float32-origin labels/minima unpacked to float64; weighted recovery and accumulation float64

confirmed_limits: The uploaded four files do not include the CPU archive, original network task pickle, collection index, preparation state, prepared shards, or raw requests.
Source file hashes/weights in a manifest are declarations until the source artifacts are independently supplied; full identity with original Table 4 inventory and checkpoint is not established.
Counts 27 tasks/56 occurrences and Platinum target are consistent with the declared reconstruction, not proof of exact published artifact identity.
67 sentinel-cost rows match the declared error count, but original error flags are absent, so error-code-to-record mapping is not independently rechecked.
The inference procedure is a Jev tournament with field descriptions and long context; Table 4 reports a trained MLP cost model. Inference differences are expected, not scorer bugs.
Appendix B/C was not independently inspected; metric alignment is to the pinned executable evaluator, consistent with the main-paper description.
Manifest collection_execution.aggregation describes intermediate macro collection diagnostics; the separate paper-network summary applies task-frequency endpoint network scores.
comparison_wording: Jev and Random were evaluated on the same reconstructed ResNet-50 pools using the pinned TenSet network metric. Published MLP + Ranking loss scores are external reference values with original inventory and checkpoint unverified.
